test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 28 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A water tank can be filled in 9 minutes by using 15 pipes of the same capacity. In how many minutes will the water tank be filled if we use 20 pipes of the same capacity as above ?
solution:
**Given:**

15 pipes can filled a tank in 9 min

**Concept used:**

M₁T₁ = M₂T₂

**Calculation:**

According to the formula

⇒ 15 x 9 = 20 x T₂

⇒ T₂ = 135 / 20 = 6.75 minutes

**⇒ Hence, 20 pipes will take 6.75 minutes**
